page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg9i.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at 3.2 GHz. The instance provides 192 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Additionally, the instance contains zero GPUs and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which are important architectural trade-offs to consider during deployment planning.

Given its high density of 192 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale workloads requiring massive parallel processing without the overhead of physical hardware management. Appropriate workloads include enterprise-grade web serving, large-scale general-purpose applications, CI/CD orchestration, and distributed data processing tasks that do not require local disk storage or GPU acceleration.
